issues.description: Naming drift: CHANGELOG/directory say compute_image_not_publicly_shared but PR description says compute_image_publicly_shared.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged that the CheckID, directory, class, and CHANGELOG must be one canonical string. The PR description disagrees with what the diff actually creates. Pick one name and make every reference match before merge.

issues.description: getIamPolicy exception path silently defaults publicly_shared=False, turning auth errors into PASS findings.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this as the wrong failure mode for a security check. A permission-denied or transient error on getIamPolicy currently produces a clean bill of health. Surface as UNKNOWN/MANUAL, skip the resource, or otherwise distinguish unreadable IAM from verified-not-public.

issues.description: _get_images iterates projects and images serially while every other collector in this file uses __threading_call__.
issues.detail: Knuth, Pike, and Torvalds all noted the inconsistency. Wall-clock is N * RTT per project with many images, and the new code does not match the voice of the surrounding file. Reuse the existing threaded helper or document a specific reason not to.

issues.description: publicly_shared boolean on the Image model bakes one check's verdict into the data structure.
issues.detail: Pike flagged and Knuth implicitly supported via the loop-invariant concern: storing a precomputed boolean prevents other checks from reusing the raw IAM members. Prefer storing the public principals (or extracting an _is_publicly_shared helper) so future checks (allUsers, role-specific exposure) can derive their own verdicts.

issues.description: Test asserts image.id.__class__.__name__ == 'str' instead of isinstance(image.id, str).
issues.detail: Knuth and Pike both called this out. The class-name string check is opaque, brittle to subclassing, and obscures intent. Use isinstance — tests are documentation for the data structure.

issues.description: images().list lacks an explicit filter or comment justifying why custom-only scope is satisfied.
issues.detail: Knuth and Torvalds both flagged this. The description claims custom images only, but no filter (e.g. deprecated.state, family) is applied. Either add the filter or add a one-line invariant comment explaining why project-scoped list already excludes Google-managed images, so future maintainers don't break it.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Three blocking issues: a name mismatch between CHANGELOG/directory and PR description, a silent-PASS failure mode where getIamPolicy exceptions default publicly_shared to False, and inconsistent serial iteration where every other collector in compute_service.py is threaded. Secondary cleanup: the Image model bakes a single check's verdict into its data shape, an awkward class-name string assertion in tests, and an unstated invariant around custom-image scoping. Core algorithm and test coverage are sound; the failure modes and consistency with surrounding code are what need fixing before merge.
